a2-review-2.R2.1 Goodbye dinner:
Narrator: It's Sunday evening in Chicago. Tomorrow Paulo is going back to New York, so Tom, Lucy and Kate are having a goodbye dinner for him at Tom and Lucy's apartment.
Lucy: Kate, have you brought the dessert yet?
Kate: Yes, I've already put it in the fridge. It's a carrot cake, of course!
Tom: Great. But the food still hasn't arrived. I ordered it an hour ago.
Paulo: What did you order?
Lucy: Burgers from the new place on our street. At first, Tom didn't want to try them, but then he loved them.
Tom: It's true. First, I tried the bean burger. Then, I tried the nut burger. Finally, I tried the sweet potato fries. Now I go there every week!
Kate: Oh, someone's at the door. At last!
Paulo: Good! I'm so hungry.
Kate: So am I!
Lucy: Paulo, I love your jacket. Is that the jacket from the magazine article?
Paulo: Yes! It's from Grace Kim, the designer who makes jackets out of old jeans. I bought it at her studio yesterday.
Tom: So, are you flying back tomorrow?
Paulo: No, I'm taking the train again. It's slow, but it's greener, because trains produce less carbon dioxide than planes. If more people take the train, the air will be cleaner.
Kate: That's true. I've just installed solar panels on the bakery, although they were expensive.
Paulo: Oh, sorry, my phone. It's my cousin Carol. Hi, Carol! Hang on a minute, I'll put you on speaker.
Carol: Hi, everyone! Paulo, thanks for your email. I'm looking forward to seeing you in New York on Friday!
Paulo: Me too! Sorry, Carol, you're breaking up. I'll call you back later.
Carol: OK, no problem. Bye!
Lucy: Hey, did you know that Grace Kelly was an American actress, and she became a princess? I listened to a podcast about her yesterday.
Tom: Really? Who did she marry?
Lucy: Prince Rainier of Monaco. They got married in 1956.
Paulo: I didn't know that!
Kate: Neither did I.
Tom: I did! My grandma loved her movies.
Kate: OK, everyone. To Paulo! Come back soon!
Paulo: I will. Thanks for everything!

a2-review-2.R2.3 Dialogues:
Narrator: Dialogue one.
Rita: Hello, City Coffee. Rita speaking. How can I help you?
Kate: Hello. Could I speak to Lucy, please?
Rita: Who's calling, please?
Kate: It's Kate Miller, from Sweet Kate Bakery.
Rita: I'm afraid she isn't here today. Would you like to leave a message?
Kate: Yes, please. Can you ask her to call me back?
Rita: Of course. I'll make sure she gets the message.
Narrator: Dialogue two.
Lucy: I'm really tired today.
Kate: So am I. I didn't sleep well.
Lucy: Neither did I. I don't like hot nights.
Kate: Me neither. But I love summer!
Lucy: So do I!
